hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer reviews her 5,600 LBG coins translated directly into pounds sterling to assess redemption options at her own pace.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer has accumulated 5,600 LBG coins across 3 connected brands and wants to understand their exact cash equivalent before deciding how to use them.
hypotheses.storyTension: Reward point abstractions and ambiguous conversion rates risk confusion and cart abandonment.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear, transparent monetary valuation and partner comparison options empower informed, pressure-free decision-making.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clarity of tangible monetary value and informed autonomy in reward choices.
completionSignals: customer interacts with partner comparison tool

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer examines alternative partner conversion rates side-by-side without pressure or urgency triggers.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer is exploring redemption partners and comparing exchange rates across multiple visits.
hypotheses.storyTension: Lack of clear rate transparency leads to hesitation and delayed commitment.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Side-by-side partner value comparison clearly highlights exact conversion yields in pounds sterling.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Informed autonomy and clarity on partner conversion efficiency.
